messages:
lee: kicking off RC-2026.3 origination. artifacts at s3://redwood-ci/rcs/2026.3.tgz — requesting pin and a short staging smoke.

deploy-bot: build rc-2026.3 (b-901) uploaded :package: sha256=aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff6600778899aabbccddeeff00112233445566778899

ana: pulling to staging, will run sha check and kv-warm (planned 15m).

qa-ron: quick note - last time kv-warm concurrency caused redis sidecar restarts. recommend concurrency=2.

lee: good call. pin and schedule with concurrency=2.

deploy-bot: pin created by lee -> pin-rc-17685. awaiting promote command.

ana: staged deploy done, kv-warm started (concurrency=2). smoke queued after warm.

[10m later]

qa-ron: smoke started -> 10/10 basic checks passed. p95 latency within baseline.

lee: approving canary plan: 2% 20m -> 30% 10m -> full. oncall-sheriff you good to monitor first window?

oncall-sheriff: watching first 10m. abort conditions: any host OOM or sustained error rate >0.5% absolute.

lee: promoting to canary now:
/deploy promote --pin pin-rc-17685 --canary 2% --canary-duration 20m --tag rc-2026.3

deploy-bot: Promotion started. canary targets provisioned (4 hosts). routing in effect.

[6m into canary]

ana: seeing repeated OOM kills on host node-ux-07 for model-worker. kernel log shows "oom_killer invoked" and restarted container.

qa-ron: error rate on canary jumped to 1.2% (5xxs). pattern matches OOMs.

oncall-sheriff: manual abort. rolling back to stable-2026.2 now.

lee: ack abort, do not re-promote until infra root cause is addressed. tagging infra-team and eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: rollback executed by oncall-sheriff. traffic restored to stable-2026.2. incident INC-2026-081 opened.

infra-team: investigating node memory pressure and autoscaler config. will collect host profiles and report back in incident.

lee: adding RC-2026.3 to blocked list in release board. will update product and schedule a retry after infra remediation.

qa-ron: note for next attempt: pre-check autoscaler headroom >=30% and run a small load test on staging before canary.

oncall-sheriff: closing thread. follow-up tracked in INC-2026-081.
